scope: Frontend product UX rebuild; no backend/schema/accounting changes, commit, push or submission ZIP modification

environment.browser: installed Google Chrome 157.0.8103.52, driven with Playwright
environment.database: native PostgreSQL 16.15, existing ledgercore_studio; not reset

chrome_real_offline_test.method: Temporary Next.js port 3002 pointing to an unused loopback backend port; real proxy HTTP 503; temporary process stopped afterwards

checks.contrast_checks: 4 primary/secondary/action text pairs pass normal-text WCAG AA; not full accessibility certification

independent_case.after_same_key_retry_source_alias_and_ch: one original receipt and journal, same balances

journeys.A: Passed at all three widths: UI borrower → loan → actual schedule → manager disbursement → officer repayment → actual journal
journeys.B: Passed at all three widths: filter known borrower → open account → balances → keyboard schedule/repayments tabs; reload retains context
journeys.C: Passed at all three widths: inherited frozen request → identical retry → source alias → one receipt → changed-payload 409; no repeated loan ID or key input

adversarial_checks: proxy route, origin and actor boundaries
actual backend commit followed by dropped HTTP response, reload, edited form and frozen exact retry: one original receipt
iteration_history: Earlier browser attempts failed on a dev-indicator obstruction, premature reload, ambiguous route-announcer alert, product-render timing and Escape before mutation settled. UI obstruction fixed; tests now wait for actual visible/enabled states. Final complete reruns passed without retries.

evidence.all_created_borrowers: invented synthetic names; real API writes appended to existing local database

limitations: No server-backed portfolio list/search API; at most 12 current-tab session references
Loan history scans at most 5000 actual global audit records
Saved schedule review occurs after origination, before disbursement
Demo impersonation only; not production authentication
One complete light theme; no dark mode
Physical devices, Safari/Firefox and full assistive-technology certification not tested
Before/after endpoint reads are observations, not atomic snapshots
Creation does not have repayment-style idempotency; uncertain origination needs inspection
